Aviso de Spray Congelante

GMDSS meteorological warning that sea spray will freeze on exposed surfaces causing topside icing hazards.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Aviso de Spray Congelante?

In this glossary, Aviso de Spray Congelante refers to: GMDSS meteorological warning that sea spray will freeze on exposed surfaces causing topside icing hazards.

How is Aviso de Spray Congelante used in maritime?

In maritime communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Rádio Costeira Reykjavík emite aviso de spray congelante válido a partir de 1800 UTC; embarcações com borda livre inferior a três metros devem considerar alterar rumo."

Definition

GMDSS meteorological warning that sea spray will freeze on exposed surfaces causing topside icing hazards.

Operational example

Coastal Radio Reykjavík issues freezing spray warning valid from 1800 UTC; vessels with freeboard under three metres must consider altering course.

Localized term

Aviso de Spray Congelante

Localized example

Rádio Costeira Reykjavík emite aviso de spray congelante válido a partir de 1800 UTC; embarcações com borda livre inferior a três metros devem considerar alterar rumo.
